parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere is the main part of the globe, made of plastic with a smooth printed surface showing the world map.
parts.Functional_description: It represents the Earth and can rotate around its axis to display different regions for educational or decorative purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around its tilted axis supported by the base structure.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the supporting structure of the globe, typically made of wood or metal, providing stability.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the rotating sphere in place and ensures the globe remains upright and balanced.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a fixed support for the rotating sphere.
